cases.question: How does Sezzle's pay-in-4 plan actually work?
cases.answer:
Sezzle's pay-in-4 plan splits a purchase into **4 equal installments over 6 weeks**:
- 25% at checkout
- 25% every 2 weeks

The schedule is fixed at order creation and shown in the app under the order detail. Installments auto-charge to the shopper's default payment method on the due date (local time, morning batch). Shoppers can pay any installment early at no cost; early payment does not change later due dates.

Sezzle charges **no interest and no fee for paying on time**. A failed-payment fee of $10 applies on the second failed charge attempt, and a reschedule fee of $5 applies on the second and third reschedule (first is free). There is no account reactivation fee for pay-in-4 orders.

cases.answer: You have 3 reschedules remaining on your Nordic Kicks order. The first reschedule is free and can push the due date of the next installment (July 11) up to 2 weeks. Each subsequent reschedule costs $5. You must request a reschedule at least 24 hours before the due date. cases.question: Does Sezzle charge interest if I pay on time?

must_include.pattern: no interest|not charge.{0,15}interest|interest.free|0% interest|never charges interest

cases.answer: Sezzle does not charge interest if you pay on time. According to our policy, **no interest is ever charged** for paying installments as scheduled. The only fees apply to failed payments, reschedules, or account reactivation, but none of these are applicable if you make your payments on time. If you have any other questions about your order or payment schedule, feel free to ask!
